text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright claims victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). She has now truly become one 
of the prominent pillars of the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by that hard-fought battle, 
Mejiro Dober decided to enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen for the sake of the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing Silence Suzuka's rapid growth 
and hearing Mejiro Dober's determination, 
Mejiro Bright requests to enter the race 
alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate goal is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)— However, the Takarazuka Kinen 
will also be an important race to gauge 
what lies ahead.
